deviations.description: Scope Hypothesis assumed one existing MT-5 per-task cleanup equivalent
deviations.reason: Live inspection of Stage MT-5 found NO existing per-task file-cleanup step at all (it only removes the shared mt_state_file/session registry entry, never touches any individual task's directory). deviations.description: lint-contract-compliance.sh's Check A hard-coded an assumption that skill-orchestrate/SKILL.md contains the core_contracts case statement
deviations.reason: That case statement was moved to orchestrate-build-dispatch.sh in Phase 3. Updated Check A to read the script instead, and to anchor precisely on the hard_mode-gated case block (the script has THREE case "$phase" in statements -- phase-arg validation, artifact-round mode, and core_contracts -- unlike SKILL.md's former single occurrence, so a naive same-shaped awk range would have captured the wrong block or run to EOF).

acceptance_prompt_byte_measurement.method: 3 real open tasks from specs/state.json (143, 142, 45), a realistic hard-mode composite (description + hard_contracts_block for implement phase [218B] + effort_note [60B], one task given a real memory-retrieve.sh match [1243B] to avoid an idealized all-zero-memory scenario)
acceptance_prompt_byte_measurement.note: A plain base-mode-only (no --hard, no memory match) measurement on the same 3 tasks -- description text alone -- gives before_total=14101, after_total=719, reduction=94.9%, also comfortably above target. Both variants reported for transparency; the after-side pointer prompt bytes are flag-independent by construction (they never grow with --hard/--lit/memory content), which is exactly the mechanism producing the reduction.
